items.title: What Did Christa Pike Do? What to Know About the Botched Tennessee Execution.
items.description: Ms. Pike, 50, survived two doses of a lethal injection in Tennessee. She was sentenced to death for the 1995 murder of a classmate.

items.title: How Did Christa Pike Survive Two Lethal Injections of Pentobarbital?
items.description: A catheter carrying the drug may not have delivered the doses to Ms. Pike’s bloodstream, experts said. The drug itself may have been degraded.
